    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractClientView
    Default no-op implementation of ClientView.
    AutoPlayerInvokedEvent
    Broadcast to all players (except the disconnected one) immediately before AutoPlayer executes each individual command on behalf of a disconnected player.
    AutoPlayerTimerStartedEvent
    Broadcast to all players (except the disconnected one) when the per-player AutoPlayer grace timer is armed.
    BoardSnapshot
    Immutable snapshot of the full board state at a given point in time.
    BoardUpdatedEvent
    Notifies all players of the card-row diff at the start of a new round.
    BuilderEffect
    Character effect for the Builder archetype.
    BuildingCard
    Represents an immutable building card template as loaded from JSON.
    BuildingCardFactory
    Factory that deserializes a BuildingCard from a Jackson JsonNode.
    BuildingDeck
    The building card deck, partitioned by era.
    BuildingEffect
    Interface for all active building effects.
    BuildingFactory
    Static factory that instantiates the correct BuildingEffect implementation for a given effect type string and its JSON parameters.
    CardCatalog
    Client-side singleton that loads all card definitions from the JSON resource files and provides formatted string representations for use in both the TUI and the GUI.
    CardNotFoundException
    Thrown when a card ID cannot be resolved — either on the board rows or inside GameRegistry.
    CardTakenEvent
    Notifies all players that a player acquired a card from the board.
    CardType
    Distinguishes between the two types of cards that players can acquire from the board.
    CavePaintingsEffect
    Event effect for the Cave Paintings event.
    CharacterCard
    Represents an immutable character card.
    CharacterEffect
    Strategy interface for the immediate effect applied to a player's tribe when a character card is drawn.
    CharacterFactory
    Factory that deserializes a CharacterCard (with the appropriate CharacterEffect) from a Jackson JsonNode.
    CharacterType
    Enumerates the six character archetypes available in the game.
    ClientApp
    Main entrance for the client application.
    ClientController
    Abstract base controller that wires the network proxy, the domain models, and the view together for the client side.
    ClientHandler
    Server-side per-client connection handler.
    ClientLauncher
    Launcher entry point for the fat JAR.
    ClientNetworkDispatcher
    Unified entry point for all inbound server notifications on the client side.
    ClientView
    Observer interface implemented by all client view implementations (TUI, GUI).
    Command
    Sealed interface for all client-to-server commands.
    CommandLogger
    File-based GameLogger that writes NDJSON (newline-delimited JSON) to logs/{gameId}.ndjson.
    CommandLogReader
    Reads a .ndjson log file written by CommandLogger and returns its contents as typed Java objects for replay.
    CommandRecord
    Pairs a deserialized GameCommand with the nickname of the player who issued it, as stored in the NDJSON log.
    ConnectionStatus
    Tracks a player's connection lifecycle within a single game session.
    ControllerManager
    Application-level singleton that manages the full lifecycle of all lobbies and game sessions on the server.
    CreateLobbyCommand
    Command requesting creation of a new lobby with the specified player capacity.
    CurrentPlayerChangedEvent
    Notifies all players that the active player has changed during totem placement.
    DuplicateCardSelectionException
    Thrown when a card selection contains the same card ID more than once.
    EffectOutcome
    Aggregates the resource changes produced by a single card effect, event resolution, or building effect callback.
    EffectVisitor
    Visitor interface used to register BuildingEffect implementations with the correct game-level observer list.
    EndGameCharacterPrestigeEffect
    Building effect that awards prestige points at game end based on the number of characters of a specific type in the owner's tribe.
    EndGameFullSetPPEffect
    Building effect that awards prestige points at game end for each complete set of all character types owned by the tribe.
    Era
    Represents the three eras of the game.
    EraChangedEvent
    Notifies all players that the game has entered a new era and the building market changed.
    ErrorEvent
    Delivers an error message to the recipient client only.
    Event
    Sealed interface for all server-to-client events.
    EventCard
    Represents an event card that applies a game-wide effect when resolved.
    EventCardNotTakeableException
    Thrown when a player's selection includes an event card.
    EventCharacterBonusEffect
    Building effect that grants food, prestige points, and/or a temporary food discount at the start of a specific event, scaled by the number of a target character type in the owner's tribe.
    EventEffect
    Strategy interface for the game-wide effect applied when an event card is resolved.
    EventFactory
    Factory that deserializes an EventCard (with the appropriate EventEffect) from a Jackson JsonNode.
    EventObserver
    Observer notified at each stage of an event card's resolution lifecycle.
    EventResolvedEvent
    Notifies all players that an event card has been resolved.
    EventType
    Enumerates the four types of events that can appear on event cards.
    ExtraTurnEffect
    Building effect that grants the owner an extra turn at the end of each round.
    ExtraTurnEndedEvent
    Notifies all players that a player's extra turn has ended.
    ExtraTurnStartedEvent
    Notifies all players that a player's extra turn has started.
    FlatPrestigeBonusEffect
    Building effect that awards a fixed number of prestige points at the end of the game.
    FullSetFoodRewardEffect
    Building effect that rewards food whenever the owner's tribe completes a new full set of all character types (i.e. gains at least one character of every CharacterType).
    Game
    Central domain object representing a single game session.
    GameAbortedEvent
    Notifies all players that the game was aborted by forfeit and declares the winner.
    GameBoard
    Manages the shared physical state of the game board: the two card rows (upper / lower), the building market rows, the offer track, the turn-order tile, and the two decks.
    GameCardView
    Graphical representation of a game card in the GUI.
    GameCommand
    Marker interface for commands sent during an active game.
    GameController
    Per-game server-side controller that bridges the network layer and the domain model for a single game session.
    GameEndedEvent
    Notifies all players that the game has ended and supplies the final scores.
    GameEvent
    Marker interface for events related to an active game session.
    GameEventEmitter
    Internal interface through which GameBoard and Game fire game-level notifications.
    GameInitRecord
    Holds all the data needed to reconstruct a Game from scratch during crash recovery.
    GameLogger
    Strategy interface for persisting the sequence of game commands to a durable log.
    GameMenuScene
    Represents the main menu scene of the game.
    GameModel
    Holds the complete client-side projection of an ongoing game session.
    GameNotifier
    Concrete implementation of both GameObserverRegistry and GameEventEmitter.
    GameObserver
    Observer that receives all game-level notifications produced by GameNotifier.
    GameObserverRegistry
    Subscription interface for managing GameObserver registrations.
    GameRecoveryFailedEvent
    Notifies all players that server-side game recovery failed.
    GameRegistry
    Singleton registry that loads and provides access to all static game data: character cards, event cards, building cards, offer tiles, and turn-order tiles.
    GameRuleException
    Abstract base class for all domain-level rule violations.
    GameScene
    The main game scene of the GUI.
    GameScene.SceneState
    Immutable snapshot of the game state for rendering and animations.
    GameSetupCompletedEvent
    Notifies all players of the initial board and player setup at game start.
    GameStartedEvent
    Notifies that the lobby game has started and supplies the game ID.
    GathererEffect
    Character effect for the Gatherer archetype.
    GlobalTimerCancelledEvent
    Notifies connected players that the global forfeit timer has been cancelled.
    GlobalTimerStartedEvent
    Notifies connected players that the global forfeit timer has been armed.
    GuiController
    Controller for the Graphical User Interface (GUI).
    GuiView
    Graphical User Interface (GUI) implementation of the client view.
    HeartbeatCommand
    Marker interface for heartbeat commands exchanged between client and server over the Socket transport layer.
    HeartbeatEvent
    Marker interface for heartbeat events exchanged between server and client over the Socket transport layer.
    HuntEffect
    Event effect for the Hunt event.
    HunterWithGigotEffect
    Character effect for a Hunter character carrying a gigot.
    ImageLoader
    Utility class for loading and caching images used in the GUI.
    InGameMenuOverlay
    Represents the overlay for the in-game menu.
    InsufficientFoodException
    Thrown when a player attempts to purchase one or more buildings but does not have enough food points to cover the total cost after applying building discounts.
    IntroScene
    Represents the introduction scene of the game.
    InvalidMoveException
    Thrown when a move is structurally valid but not permitted in the current game state — e.g. calling moveTotem() or resolveActions() during a phase that does not support it, or specifying an illegal destination tile.
    InventionType
    Enumerates the ten invention types that Inventor characters can contribute.
    InventorEffect
    Character effect for the Inventor archetype.
    InventorPairRewardEffect
    Building effect that rewards food whenever the owner's tribe accumulates a new pair of Inventors sharing the same InventionType.
    JoinLobbyCommand
    Command requesting that the client join an existing lobby.
    JsonMessageCodec
    JSON-specific specialization of MessageCodec.
    JsonMessageCodecImpl
    Jackson-based implementation of JsonMessageCodec.
    LeaveLobbyCommand
    Command requesting that the client leave their current lobby.
    Lobby
    Represents a pre-game lobby in which players gather before the match starts.
    LobbyCommand
    Marker interface for commands sent during the pre-game (lobby) phase.
    LobbyDissolvedEvent
    Notifies the client that their current lobby has been dissolved.
    LobbyEvent
    Marker interface for events related to the pre-game lobby phase.
    LobbyInfo
    Immutable snapshot of a lobby's current state, broadcast to all pre-lobby clients whenever the lobby list changes.
    LobbyListScene
    Represents the lobby list scene of the game.
    LobbyModel
    Holds the client-side state of the pre-game lobby phase.
    LobbyScene
    Represents the lobby scene of the game.
    Message
    Root sealed interface for all network messages exchanged between client and server.
    MessageCodec
    Codec for serializing and deserializing Message objects to and from a string representation.
    ModelInterface
    Minimal abstraction of the game model exposed to the controller layer.
    MoveTotemCommand
    In-game command requesting that the current player move their totem to an offer tile or return it to the turn-order tile.
    NetworkDefaults
    Default network endpoints shared by client and server.
    NetworkPopup
    Utility class for building a network connection popup.
    NetworkPopup.ConnectionConfig
    Record representing the connection configuration.
    NetworkServer
    Abstraction for a network server that accepts client connections on a given port and dispatches them to the appropriate ClientHandler implementation.
    NetworkServerFactory
    Factory for creating NetworkServer instances based on the chosen network technology.
    NetworkType
    Enumerates the two supported network transport protocols.
    NewEraOverlay
    Represents an animated overlay displayed when a new era begins.
    NoEffect
    A no-op CharacterEffect used for character types that produce no immediate resource change when drawn (e.g.
    NoOpCommandLogger
    No-operation GameLogger that silently discards all calls.
    NotYourTurnException
    Thrown when a player attempts to act outside their designated turn.
    OfferTile
    Represents a single offer tile on the offer track.
    OfferTileInfo
    Immutable snapshot of a single offer tile's state.
    OfferTilesFactory
    Factory that deserializes an OfferTile from a Jackson JsonNode.
    OfferTileView
    Graphical representation of an offer tile in the GUI.
    OfferTrack
    The offer track: the ordered collection of OfferTiles on which players place their totems during the totem-placement phase.
    PhaseChangedEvent
    Notifies all players of a phase transition.
    PhaseObserver
    Observer notified whenever the game transitions between phases.
    PhaseType
    Enumerates every distinct phase in the game FSM.
    PickLimitExceededException
    Thrown when a card selection exceeds the remaining pick allowance for the upper row, lower row, or extra-turn limits on the player's current OfferTile.
    PickObligationNotFulfilledException
    Thrown when a player attempts to return their totem to the TurnOrderTile before satisfying all mandatory pick obligations (i.e. remaining upper or lower picks are still non-zero and eligible cards are available).
    PingCommand
    Heartbeat probe sent by the client to verify server liveness.
    PingEvent
    Heartbeat probe sent by the server to verify client liveness.
    Player
    Represents a player in the game, identified by a unique nickname and a totem color.
    PlayerDisconnectedEvent
    Notifies all players that a specific player has disconnected.
    PlayerFinalScore
    Immutable breakdown of a player's final prestige-point score.
    PlayerLimitsInitializedEvent
    Notifies all players of the active player's initial pick limits for their turn.
    PlayerLimitsUpdatedEvent
    Notifies all players of the active player's updated remaining pick counts.
    PlayerNotFoundException
    Thrown when a nickname cannot be resolved to a known Player instance.
    PlayerNotOnTileException
    Thrown when the system expects a player to be occupying an OfferTile but no tile holds that player.
    PlayerReconnectedEvent
    Notifies all players that a specific player has reconnected.
    PlayerResourceChangedEvent
    Notifies all players that a player's resource value has changed.
    PlayerSidebarItem
    Represents an item in the player sidebar of the GUI.
    PongCommand
    Heartbeat response sent by the client in reply to a server PingEvent.
    PongEvent
    Heartbeat response sent by the server in reply to a client PingCommand.
    PrestigePointMultiplierPerTypeEffect
    Building effect that multiplies the prestige points earned by Builder characters at the end of the game.
    ProjectInfo
     
    ProjectInfoScene
    Represents the project information scene.
    ReconnectCommand
    Command requesting reconnection to an ongoing game.
    RegistrationVisitor
    Concrete EffectVisitor that registers building effects with the appropriate observer lists in the current Game and Tribu.
    ReservePileView
    Graphical representation of the common reserve in the GUI.
    ResolveActionsCommand
    In-game command requesting card acquisition for the current player.
    ResourceDelta
    Represents a single resource change for one player.
    ResourcePaths
    Classpath locations of bundled JSON data files.
    ResourceType
    Enumerates every resource tracked per player and reported in ResourceDelta notifications.
    RmiClientHandler
    Server-side handler for a single RMI-connected client.
    RmiClientRemote
    RMI remote interface exposed by the client to the server.
    RmiServer
    NetworkServer implementation for the RMI transport.
    RmiServerFactory
    RMI remote interface acting as the server-side entry point for new client connections.
    RmiServerProxy
    RMI proxy on the client side.
    RmiServerRemote
    RMI remote interface exposing client-to-server game and lobby operations.
    RowPosition
    Identifies which card row a card was drawn from or belongs to.
    SceneRouter
    Router class for managing GUI scenes and navigation.
    SelectTotemCommand
    Command requesting totem selection within the current lobby.
    ServerApp
     
    ServerProxy
    Client-side abstraction for the connection to the game server.
    ServerProxyFactory
    Factory for creating ServerProxy instances.
    SetUsernameCommand
    Command requesting that the server assign the given nickname to this client.
    ShamanEffect
    Character effect for the Shaman archetype.
    ShamanicExtraIconsEffect
    Building effect that temporarily adds bonus shaman stars to the owner's tribe for the duration of the Shamanic Ritual event.
    ShamanicImmunityEffect
    Building effect that makes the owner's tribe immune to the minority penalty during the Shamanic Ritual event.
    ShamanicRitualEffect
    Event effect for the Shamanic Ritual event.
    ShamanicWinMultiplierEffect
    Building effect that multiplies the prestige bonus the owner received for winning the Shamanic Ritual event.
    SocketClientHandler
    Server-side handler for a single Socket-connected client.
    SocketServer
    NetworkServer implementation for the Socket transport.
    SocketServerProxy
    Socket-based proxy on the client side.
    SummaryCardOverlay
    Represents the overlay for the summary card.
    SustenanceEffect
    Event effect for the Sustenance event.
    TileNotFoundException
    Thrown when a tile ID does not correspond to any tile on the board.
    TileOccupiedException
    Thrown when a player tries to place their totem on an OfferTile that is already occupied by another player's totem.
    Totem
    Enumerates the five totem colors, one per player slot.
    TotemPlacedEvent
    Notifies all players that a player placed their totem on an offer tile.
    TotemReturnedEvent
    Notifies all players that a player returned their totem to the turn-order tile.
    Tribu
    Represents a player's tribe — the central aggregate that tracks all resources, characters, buildings, inventions, and passive effects accumulated during the game.
    TribuDeck
    The main draw deck containing all character and non-building event cards, stacked in era order (Era I on top, final events at the bottom).
    TribuObserver
    Observer notified whenever a character card is inserted into a tribe.
    TuiController
    TUI-specific input handler that reads commands from standard input and dispatches them to the appropriate ClientController actions.
    TuiView
    Text-based user interface for the MESOS game client.
    TurnOrderCaveView
    Graphical representation of the turn order cave in the GUI.
    TurnOrderEstablishedEvent
    Notifies all players of the turn order for the upcoming round.
    TurnOrderFoodBonusEffect
    Building effect that grants one extra food point at the end of each player turn, provided the owner's current turn-order position carries a positive food reward.
    TurnOrderSlotInfo
    Immutable snapshot of a single slot on the turn-order tile.
    TurnOrderTile
    The turn-order tile: a fixed-size array of player positions that determines the order in which players place their totems in the next round.
    TurnOrderTile.TurnOrderRewardResult
     
    TurnOrderTilesFactory
    Factory that deserializes a TurnOrderTile from a Jackson JsonNode.
    UpdatedLobbiesEvent
    Pushes an updated list of available lobbies to pre-lobby clients.
    UpdatedLobbyEvent
    Pushes an update for the lobby the client is currently in.
    UsernameResultEvent
    Notifies that a username request was accepted or rejected.
    VirtualControllerManager
    Granular interface through which network handlers communicate with the server controller layer.
    VirtualServer
    Client-side abstraction of the server.
    VirtualView
    Server-side abstraction of a connected client.
    VirtualView.NoOp
    Silent no-operation implementation used during server-side replay.
